scope: Merchant overview design and its read-only projection; local application only
design: Reference composition: navy sidebar and topbar, skyline/flag hero, five KPI cards, sales chart, status rings, recent source records, quick actions and account information.
Responsive desktop, tablet and mobile navigation; generated hero, existing NUERS/Powered By logos and Lucide SVG icons.
Visible data is fetched from authenticated merchant membership; reference business names, counts, percentages and dates are not hardcoded.

alignment.behavior: Own merchant derived from authenticated account ID; query merchant_id is ignored; foreign records are excluded; client role is rejected.

Canonical source documents counted once. Financially reconciled primary invoices and linked credit/debit adjustments determine sales; payment events are separate. Integer-centavo arithmetic is converted to PHP currency at the API boundary.

Philippine calendar-day metrics, actual prior-calendar-day comparisons, 7/30-day charts, bounded recent list, zero/empty/loading/error states and visible refresh time. No invented baseline percentages.
Acknowledgment requires the common authentic production proof predicate. Local queue/attention/unknown states are distinct. No BIR submission action is exposed by this view.
NUERS response observation is distinct from unverified BIR connectivity. Seeded health or sample SLA values are not used as infrastructure evidence.
Credit/debit navigation filters both adjustment types within the existing own-merchant invoice endpoint. Originals are not modified by dashboard actions.

intentional_reference_adjustments: Document Status replaces Transaction Status in the source-document ring; receipt/payment records are not treated as BIR acceptance.
Sales Summary (Draft) links to the existing internal tax/sales view; no official SLS format or completed tax return is claimed.
Account Security replaces unsupported merchant-wide User Management; Invoice Settings uses the existing merchant configuration route.
Customer lookup explicitly derives from the latest eight own source documents. It is a recent-buyer lookup, not a complete verified customer registry or a contact-editing service.
Business Date is shown for date-only source invoices; no fabricated issuance time is added. Missing plan/RDO/account evidence remains unrecorded.
The global requested black-letter Powered By logo remains included.

verification.build_warning: Existing large JavaScript chunks and runtime image URL references remain; no capacity benchmark claim.

main_database.scope: Read-only local main database, not a live deployment

browser_qa.database: Separate synthetic SQLite fixture on temporary localhost:8002; no main financial data copied or modified.
interactions: Support form opened without submitting a message
Mobile query navigation closes the drawer

limitations: Official BIR contract, adapter, permissions and authentic end-to-end projections remain dependencies from the earlier full audit.
No load, DDoS, failover or production deployment performed. High-volume projection performance and independent security/resilience assessments remain unverified.
Dashboard scope does not constitute a new complete-project audit or certify all pre-existing destination pages.

font_followup.layout: Wider navigation and roomier cards/rows; secondary text contrast improved; narrow screens reflow cards and keep source tables horizontally scrollable.

verification.scope: Styles and chart typography; application logic and database schema unchanged.
